name: veil-social

scripts.test: npm run test:crypto && npm test --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run generate && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.deploy:web: npm --prefix frontend run build && npx wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist/client --project-name=social-space
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:secrets && npm test && npm run build

description: Social Space: anonymous social network on Cloudflare (Pages + Workers + D1 + R2).
